title: Beacon Hill Park Horse-Drawn Carriage Experience in Victoria
includes: Warm faux-fur blankets for cooler evenings
Convertible roof to maximize comfort in all weather
Maximum 4 people per carriage; however recommend not more than 4 adults to ensure your comfort.
Evening tours will be lit with the soft glow of carriage lanterns
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Carriages seat a maximum of 4 people

All tours are subject to weather. In the event of inclement weather (ice, snow, high winds), your local tour operator will try to contact you via the information provided, else please call to confirm your reservation.
Wheelchair accessible: person must be able to transfer themselves into the carriage
Dog friendly (we love them, but please keep them off the seats)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unforgettable Experience
Tally-Ho is proud to be one of Victoria’s top-rated attractions, with glowing 5-star reviews. Guests love our friendly guides, well-cared-for horses, and the relaxed pace that makes every ride unforgettable.

A Tour with Heart & Heritage
Our guides don’t just share history—they bring it to life. Each tour is tailored with fascinating stories, horse insights, and local tips, creating a concierge-style experience that feels personal and unique.

A Rare Connection with Horses
Guests will meet, connect, and take photos with our gentle, endangered-breed horses —an intimate, hands-on experience you won’t find anywhere else.

120+ Years of Tradition
Launched in 1903, Tally-Ho has been a treasured part of Victoria’s story for more than a century, delighting generations of visitors.

A Living Piece of History
With iconic carriages, beloved horses, and heartfelt storytelling, Tally-Ho offers a one-of-a-kind journey that honors the past while creating lasting memories.
